message: reveal lord (grantFact portal_name; exercised, not earned)

fn: async () => { /* G0 reveal lord's contact via the real grantFact path */ const mod=await import('/break_escape/js/systems/social-intel.js'); mod.grantFact('portal_name'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); try{window.stateSync&&window.stateSync.sync&&window.stateSync.sync();}catch(e){} return window.gameState.globalVariables.se_intel_portal_name===true; }
async () => { /* V0 (600px) the viewport is a real 600px wide */ const w=window.innerWidth, c=document.documentElement.clientWidth; return w>0 && w<=601 && c>0 && c<=601; }
async () => { /* A1 (600px) the builder opened */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; return !!mg && mg.constructor.name==='LandingPageBuilderMinigame'; }

async () => { /* BUILD (600px) set a valid page through the real chip-pick path */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const pick=(f)=>{const e=mg.container.querySelector('[data-focus="'+f+'"]'); if(e){e.click();return true;} return false;}; pick('brand:ledgerwell'); pick('purpose:payslip'); pick('domain:d_word'); pick('logo:crisp'); pick('wording:w_formal'); const cur=new Set(mg.choices.fields||[]); ['email','password','one_time_code','card_number','ni_number'].forEach(f=>{ const want=['email','password'].includes(f); if(want!==cur.has(f)) pick('form:'+f); }); if(mg.choices.padlock!==true) pick('padlock:on'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); const c=mg.getTestState().builder.choices; return c.brand==='ledgerwell' && c.domainId==='d_word' && c.logo==='crisp' && c.padlock===true && JSON.stringify(c.fields.slice().sort())===JSON.stringify(['email','password']); }

async () => { /* L1 (600px) the builder window is narrow (96vw path, not 1180px) */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const gc=mg.gameContainer || mg.root.closest('.lpb-game-container'); const w=gc.getBoundingClientRect().width; return w>0 && w<=600 && w<1180; }

async () => { /* L2 (600px) the panes stack into a column (media query live) */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const body=mg.root.querySelector('.lpb-body'); const fd=getComputedStyle(body).flexDirection; const pane=mg.previewPane.getBoundingClientRect(); const panel=mg.panel.getBoundingClientRect(); const stacked = pane.bottom <= panel.top + 2; const leftAligned = Math.abs(pane.left - panel.left) <= 2; return fd==='column' && stacked && leftAligned; }

async () => { /* L3 (600px) no horizontal overflow; the preview fits the pane and the viewport */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const root=mg.root; const gc=mg.gameContainer; const rootOk = root.scrollWidth <= root.clientWidth + 1; const gcOk = gc.scrollWidth <= gc.clientWidth + 1; const prev=mg.previewPane.querySelector('.lpb-preview'); const pr=prev.getBoundingClientRect(); const fitsViewport = pr.right <= window.innerWidth + 1; const paneFits = pr.width <= mg.previewPane.clientWidth + 1; return rootOk && gcOk && fitsViewport && paneFits; }

async () => { /* L4 (600px) the preview drew the page, inert, with a .example address */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const prev=mg.previewPane.querySelector('.lpb-preview'); if(!prev) return false; const blocked = prev.classList.contains('is-blocked'); const bodyEl = prev.querySelector('.lpb-body'); const addr = prev.querySelector('.lpb-address-text'); const addrText = addr ? addr.textContent.trim() : ''; const forbidden = mg.previewPane.querySelectorAll('a, form, input, textarea, select, button, iframe, script, [contenteditable]').length; const typed = mg.container.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]').length; return !blocked && !!bodyEl && addrText.includes('.example') && addrText!=='Blocked address' && forbidden===0 && typed===0; }

async () => { /* L5 (600px) chips and action buttons are still at least 44px */ const mg=window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const controls=[...mg.container.querySelectorAll('.lpb-chip, .lpb-score-btn, .lpb-close')]; if(!controls.length) return false; return controls.every(el=>{ const h=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).minHeight)||el.getBoundingClientRect().height; return h>=44; }); }
